query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS (SELECT id FROM tracks WHERE availability IN (?, ?)) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM albums al WHERE al.id = ? AND al.id IN (SELECT t.album_id FROM tracks t JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = t.id))
